keypoint_split_resolution.test_policy: test-only pickle was never opened or run in P1

split_policy.assignment: first uint64 of SHA256('20260912:'+video_name), big-endian; calibration iff value < 0.2*2^64
split_policy.dev_use: one-shot threshold-free detection evaluation after pre-dev freeze; no feedback into choices

target.identity: alignment-derived nonblank segment midpoint proxy; not manual ground truth

features.causality: features at t read keypoints only at frames <=t
features.nonfinite_policy: explicit validity mask; invalid landmark-frames excluded from motion/bbox and reflected in valid_fraction

predictor.standardization: mean and scale from fit rows only
predictor.regularization: C=1.0; equivalent summed-loss L2 coefficient 1.0; intercept unpenalized
predictor.optimizer: deterministic SciPy CPU L-BFGS, maximum 200 iterations

calibration.event_policy: causal upward threshold crossing followed by 4-frame refractory
calibration.gate: center recall within +/-1 >=0.75 and matched positive-delay fraction <=0.25
calibration.outcome: no feasible threshold; selected threshold is null
calibration.scheduler_policy: do not run scheduler replay when gate fails
